samples.label: Boguslawsky Crater Rim & Floor
samples.description: High-resolution orbital observation of Boguslawsky crater showing steep rim topography, terraced walls, and localized micro-craters on the floor.

samples.label: South Pole Shackleton Rim (PSR)
samples.description: High-contrast polar observation showing sharp sunlit peaks and deep permanently shadowed regions (PSRs) candidate cold-traps for water ice.

samples.label: Mare Regolith & Fresh Ejecta Rays
samples.description: Multi-spectral stereo observation exhibiting immature high-albedo ejecta ray blankets over basaltic mare regolith.
